basic_details.job_title: Kerala University Casual Conductor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University has notified vacancy for the Casual Conductor post on a temporary and daily wage basis for 89 days. Candidates holding SSLC or equivalent with a valid Motor Vehicle Driving License for light motor vehicles can apply online. The prescribed pay is Rs. 710 per day, up to a maximum of Rs. 19,170 per month. The selection process consists of an online application, a physical fitness test, and a driving test or interview under advertisement number 40676/2019/UOK. The last date to submit the online application is 28 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruit.keralauniversity.ac.in/homePage.
Register and log in with a valid E-mail ID.
Fill out the online application form and upload the required certificates and documents.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 250 for General candidates or Rs. 125 for SC/ST candidates through online payment mode only.
Submit the online application before 5.00 PM on 28 October 2026. Do not send the hard copy to the university.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility conditions to apply for the Casual Conductor position: Educational Qualification: SSLC / Secondary or equivalent qualification. Technical Qualification: Valid Motor Vehicle Driving License for light motor vehicles issued by the Motor Vehicles Department. Age Limit: Must not exceed 40 years as of 01.01.2026. Age relaxations apply to SC/ST and OBC candidates as per prevailing government rules. Physical Standards: Minimum height of 158 cm and minimum chest girth of 76 cm. Candidates with physical disabilities are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala University Casual Conductor
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruit.keralauniversity.ac.in/homePage . Register and log in with a valid E-mail ID. Fill out the online application form and upload the required certificates and documents. Pay the application fee of Rs. 250 for General candidates or Rs. 125 for SC/ST candidates through online payment mode only. Submit the online application before 5.00 PM on 28 October 2026. Do not send the hard copy to the university.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection involves preparing a panel of candidates through an online application process, followed by verification of physical standards, a physical fitness test (including eye test) certified by a medical officer not below the rank of Assistant Civil Surgeon in Government Medical Dispensaries, and subsequent selection stages such as a driving test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kerala University Casual Conductors Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 28 October 2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Casual Conductors post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC or equivalent and possess a valid Motor Vehicle Driving License for light motor vehicles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the daily wage offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a daily wage of Rs. 710 per day, subject to a monthly maximum of Rs. 19,170.

faq.question: Q4. Is this appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary on a daily wage basis for 89 days, and selected candidates do not have any claim to regular employment, pension, or reappointment.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable to SC/ST and OBC candidates as per the prevailing rules of the university and government norms.
